asset.description: 六個城市(A-F)的鄰接表格圖，用箭頭/勾號標示單向道路連通關係

content_en.prompt: Ravi signed up to play a map game with a table instead of a map. There are six cities A-F. An arrow in the table means a one-way road from the row city to the column city; no arrow means no direct road (e.g. there's a one-way road from City B to City C but not from B to D).
content_en.question: Is it true that at least three one-way roads are needed to get from...
content_en.explanation: C→A→B uses only 2 roads (statement A false). From A, you can only go to B then to C — needing at least one more road to reach D, so at least 3 roads total (statement B true). A→B→C uses only 2 roads (statement C false). B→C→E uses only 2 roads (statement D false).
content_en.ct_explanation: The map is a directed graph (digraph): vertices (cities) connected by directed edges (one-way roads). A directed graph can also be represented as an adjacency matrix, like the table in this task. Representing data in multiple ways is very common in computer science — pictures are visual and nice for humans to read, while matrix/table forms can be easier for computers to manipulate.

content_zh.prompt: Ravi報名玩一個地圖遊戲，玩家拿到的不是地圖，而是一張表格。表格裡有六個城市A-F，表格中的箭頭代表「從列所在城市到欄所在城市」有一條單向道路；沒有箭頭就代表這兩個城市之間沒有直達道路（例如：從B城到C城有單向道路，但B城到D城沒有）。
content_zh.question: 以下哪一段路程，最少需要三條單向道路才能到達？
content_zh.explanation: C→A→B只需要2條路（所以選項A錯）。從A城出發，只能先到B城、再到C城，還需要至少再走一條路才能到D城，所以至少需要3條路（選項B正確）。A→B→C只需要2條路（選項C錯）。B→C→E只需要2條路（選項D錯）。
content_zh.ct_skills: 拆解（Decomposition）、抽象化（Abstraction）、演算法思維（Algorithmic Thinking）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這張地圖其實就是一個「有向圖」：城市是頂點，單向道路是連接頂點的有向邊。有向圖也可以用「鄰接矩陣」這種表格形式來表示，就像這一題給的表格一樣。用多種方式表示同一份資料，在資訊科學裡非常常見——圖像對人類來說直觀好讀，而表格/矩陣形式則往往更方便電腦處理運算。
